ios.desc:
Dialed: Visual Time Management Reimagined

See your schedule at a glance with Dialed’s radial clock interface. Plan your day, track time, and stay organized.

THE RADIAL CLOCK INTERFACE

View your schedule on a circular dial. Tasks appear as color-coded segments around the clock, making it easy to see what’s coming and how your day is structured.

KEY FEATURES

Visual Schedule - See all your tasks displayed on a beautiful radial clock interface

Smart Calendar Sync - Import events directly from your Calendar app with one tap

Color-Coded Tasks - Organize your schedule with custom colors and icons for each task

Drag & Drop Editing - Adjust task times by simply dragging segments on the clock

Daily Calendar View - Browse and manage tasks by date with an intuitive calendar interface

Time Analytics - Track total hours, view productivity trends, and gain insights into how you spend your time

Beautiful Themes - Choose from multiple carefully designed themes to match your style

24-Hour Format - Toggle between 12-hour and 24-hour display formats

Intuitive Navigation - Simple, focused interface that gets out of your way

PREMIUM FEATURES

Unlock the full experience with Dialed Pro lifetime purchase:

Unlimited Tasks - Create as many tasks as you need without restrictions

Advanced Analytics - Detailed insights, productivity trends, and comprehensive time distribution analysis

Recurring Tasks - Set tasks to repeat automatically on your schedule

Custom Themes - Personalize your app appearance to match your preferences

PERFECT FOR
Professionals managing busy schedules, students planning study sessions, and anyone who wants a visual approach to time management. If you prefer seeing your entire day at a glance rather than scrolling through lists, Dialed is for you.

PRIVACY FIRST

Your data stays on your device. Calendar access is completely optional and only used to import events when you choose to sync.
Download Dialed today and experience a new way to manage your time.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Dialed – A Radial Calendar App for iOS

quotes.text:
Hey HN! I just launched Dialed – a calendar app where your day is visualized as a clock instead of a grid.
I've always found traditional calendar UIs frustrating. Lists feel like todo apps. Grids feel like spreadsheets. But we experience time circularly, like a clock face.

A few months ago I saw a radial planning concept and couldn't stop thinking about it. Started building that week.

Key features:

Day visualized as 24-hour clock
Tasks/events as colored arcs
Apple Calendar sync
Time analytics (planned vs actual)
Custom themes

Built in Swift/SwiftUI. The radial layout was harder than expected – lots of edge cases around midnight wrapping and overlapping events.

This is my first iOS launch. Would love feedback on whether the radial metaphor works for you guys!
